evidence.claim: Amnesty said unzureichende Ermittlungen bei Vorwürfen über diskriminierende Personenkontrollen and the lack of an independent complaint mechanism continued to block justice for police abuse complaints in Germany.
evidence.title: Deutschland 2022
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said unzureichende Ermittlungen bei Vorwürfen über diskriminierende Personenkontrollen and the lack of an independent complaint mechanism continued to block justice for police abuse complaints in Germany.
evidence.source_locator: Berichtszeitraum 1. Januar 2022 bis 31. Dezember 2022; section on 'Recht auf Gerechtigkeit, Wahrheit und Wiedergutmachung'
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Major rights-organization country report covering the full target year; specific findings are explicit and well-sourced.
evidence.period_fit: Directly covers 2022 and names the relevant police-accountability gap.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect ruler attribution only; this is a national institutional condition under Scholz's government, not a personal order.
contrary_evidence: Germany remained an open reporting environment rather than a closed repressive system.
The report criticizes investigation quality, not a pattern of systematic state terror.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said some protests were disproportionately restricted and that a court held permanent protest camps protected by the freedom of assembly.
evidence.title: Deutschland 2022
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said some protests were disproportionately restricted and that a court held permanent protest camps protected by the freedom of assembly.
evidence.source_locator: Berichtszeitraum 1. Januar 2022 bis 31. Dezember 2022; section on 'Recht auf Versammlungsfreiheit'
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Same annual report, but this is a distinct claim on protest rights and restrictions with direct 2022 relevance.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect attribution to the federal political environment under Scholz; protest control was mostly exercised by Länder and local authorities.
contrary_evidence: The same report also notes a court-protected protest-camp precedent, so the picture is mixed rather than uniformly repressive.
The restrictions discussed are not evidence of nationwide political terror.

evidence.claim: Amnesty reported that in August 2022 a 16-year-old Senegalese refugee was killed by several shots from a machine gun during a disproportionate police operation, with criminal investigations still ongoing at year-end.
evidence.title: Deutschland 2022
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty reported that in August 2022 a 16-year-old Senegalese refugee was killed by several shots from a machine gun during a disproportionate police operation, with criminal investigations still ongoing at year-end.
evidence.source_locator: Berichtszeitraum 1. Januar 2022 bis 31. Dezember 2022; section on discrimination / police action
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Specific, contemporaneous, and materially important incident documented by a leading rights NGO.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Weak-to-indirect national attribution: a police killing under a Scholz-era government, but operational control was regional and incident-specific.
contrary_evidence: The report describes an isolated severe incident, not a generalized national terror policy.
Investigations were still ongoing, so final legal responsibility was unsettled at year-end.

evidence.claim: The Court held that Germany failed to secure an effective independent investigation into an arguable racial-profiling complaint arising from a police identity check, violating Article 14 in conjunction with Article 8.
evidence.title: BASU c. ALLEMAGNE
evidence.excerpt: The Court held that Germany failed to secure an effective independent investigation into an arguable racial-profiling complaint arising from a police identity check, violating Article 14 in conjunction with Article 8.
evidence.source_locator: Judgment summary, introduction and key holding
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Authoritative judicial finding from the ECHR on a German policing and discrimination case.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 judgment, directly relevant to the year's accountability environment.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Institutional attribution, not personal; it reflects state-level investigative failure under Scholz's chancellorship.
contrary_evidence: The case concerns a 2012 stop and the adequacy of later review, not a 2022 order by Scholz.
It shows a remedy failure more than direct policy abuse.

evidence.claim: The Federal Administrative Court held that a protest camp can generally count as a protected assembly under Article 8 GG and that its necessary infrastructure can also fall under assembly protection.
evidence.title: Versammlungsrechtlicher Schutz eines Protestcamps und seiner infrastrukturellen Einrichtungen
evidence.excerpt: The Federal Administrative Court held that a protest camp can generally count as a protected assembly under Article 8 GG and that its necessary infrastructure can also fall under assembly protection.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Binding domestic court decision on protest rights and their protection scope.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indicates the legal environment under Scholz's government, not a personal directive by Scholz.
contrary_evidence: The case also confirms that authorities may still limit duration in some circumstances.
This is a legal-protection source, not evidence of executive restraint by itself.

evidence.claim: The cabinet adopted a draft law to strengthen measures for democratic participation, diversity, extremism prevention, and political education.
evidence.title: Bundeskabinett - Ergebnisse
evidence.excerpt: The cabinet adopted a draft law to strengthen measures for democratic participation, diversity, extremism prevention, and political education.
evidence.source_locator: TOP-1-Liste / agenda items for the 44th cabinet meeting on 14 December 2022
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official cabinet decision published on the federal government site, contemporaneous with the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Cabinet-level action under Scholz; precise implementation and downstream effect remain broader than Scholz alone.
contrary_evidence: This is a draft-law decision, not proof of immediate harm reduction.
The measure is preventive and institutional, so its effect is indirect.

evidence.claim: Scholz said the Nazis had begun their murderous intent by trying to erase Jewish life and used the speech to reaffirm Germany's historical responsibility toward Jewish life and remembrance.
evidence.title: Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz zu 25 Jahren Freundeskreis Yad Vashem in Deutschland
evidence.excerpt: Scholz said the Nazis had begun their murderous intent by trying to erase Jewish life and used the speech to reaffirm Germany's historical responsibility toward Jewish life and remembrance.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct Scholz speech in the federal bulletin archive.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 speech, useful for public stance and vulnerable-group protection context.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Scholz rhetoric; it is a public statement, not an operational security order.
contrary_evidence: Rhetoric is not the same as enforcement or complaint-handling reform.
The speech is symbolic and commemorative, not a concrete anti-violence program.

evidence.claim: The federal government decided that from 1 June 2022 Ukrainian refugees could access basic social-security benefits, healthcare coverage, integration courses, and job-center support, with Germany4Ukraine as a central information portal.
evidence.title: Couverture de base pour les réfugiés ukrainiens
evidence.excerpt: The federal government decided that from 1 June 2022 Ukrainian refugees could access basic social-security benefits, healthcare coverage, integration courses, and job-center support, with Germany4Ukraine as a central information portal.
evidence.source_locator: Archival article dated 27 April 2022; sections 'Aides provenant d'une source unique' and support details
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous government decision and implementation summary with concrete benefits and dates.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Cabinet-level attribution under Scholz; this is executive policy in the target year.
contrary_evidence: This is protection and integration policy, not direct evidence on policing or political violence.
The policy concerns refugees from Ukraine, so it is a targeted vulnerable-group measure rather than a universal domestic-safety fix.

evidence.claim: The government bill would create internal and external reporting channels for violations and protect whistleblowers against professional retaliation.
evidence.title: Entwurf zum besserer Schutz von Whistleblowern beraten
evidence.excerpt: The government bill would create internal and external reporting channels for violations and protect whistleblowers against professional retaliation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official Bundestag report on a government bill with explicit accountability mechanisms.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate-to-strong: the measure reflects the Scholz government's legislative agenda, though the page does not show personal direction by the chancellor himself.
contrary_evidence: This is a bill under debate, not proof of enforcement or use.
It is broader accountability architecture rather than police-specific reform.

evidence.claim: The Bundestag debate records coalition support for 1,000 new federal police posts and a forthcoming modern Bundespolizeigesetz, while opponents pressed for an independent federal police commissioner.
evidence.title: Kontroverse Debatte zu Befugnissen der Bundespolizei
evidence.excerpt: The Bundestag debate records coalition support for 1,000 new federal police posts and a forthcoming modern Bundespolizeigesetz, while opponents pressed for an independent federal police commissioner.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official parliamentary debate record; strong for what federal actors argued, weaker for actual Scholz-level execution.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect: this is coalition-level federal policy under Scholz, but the debate does not isolate his personal decision-making.
contrary_evidence: It records debate, not enacted oversight outcomes.
The police-accountability issue remains partly Länder-level and partly post-2022.

unresolved_gaps: Direct evidence on internal nuclear-safety alternatives and command-and-control review is still thin.
Internal cabinet deliberations and precise alternative options around the Ukraine response are not visible.
Most policing and complaint-handling evidence is Länder-level, so direct Scholz attribution remains limited.
Direct evidence of 2022 Scholz-led democratic strengthening is thinner than evidence of institutional baseline and judicial constraint.
Direct chancellor-level evidence on personnel selection, correction after failure, and anti-capture choices remains limited.
Post-enactment delivery quality and longer-run durability of the reforms are not fully shown in the 2022 package.
Direct primary evidence on assets, gifts, family benefit, hidden conflicts, or formal self-dealing is missing.
The record remains allegation-heavy rather than adjudication-heavy on deception and obstruction.
Direct evidence on Scholz's personnel selection, correction of underperformers, and internal discipline is thinner than evidence on program design and rollout.
